candidates.basis: statement_rows starts running at 0 and adds every entry in posting order, including entries dated before --since. render_statement prints Opening balance as balance_before(account, since), which sums entries by date. When posting order differs from date order, the first listed row's running balance does not continue from the opening balance. Criterion-3 requires each row's running balance to continue from the opening balance, and this change adds the statement code, so the change is responsible. Ledger.post and Ledger.transfer accept any day, so out-of-order entries are reachable. In the trigger example the opening balance is 10.00 and the first row should show 60.00, but the head prints 50.00.
